subject.title: fix(hooks): deliver internal hook replies on replyable surfaces

question: Should OpenClaw restore message:received event.messages auto-delivery as a supported hook contract, or keep current main's documented message:* non-delivery behavior?
rationale: The latest release docs promised message:received reply delivery, but current main now documents the opposite, and the implementation crosses outbound send-policy and routing security boundaries.

options.title: Repair and restore delivery
options.body: Rebase this PR and require sendPolicy gating, sender-target routing, current routeReply metadata, runtime guards, and focused tests before merge.

options.title: Keep current main contract
options.body: Close or narrow this PR and update the linked issue with the decision that message:received hooks may observe but not auto-reply.

options.title: Split the decision
options.body: Land only docs/contract clarification now and open a separate owner-reviewed design for safe hook reply delivery.

recommendation.title: Repair and restore delivery
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR and require sendPolicy gating, sender-target routing, current routeReply metadata, runtime guards, and focused tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the most recent current-main hook dispatch and docs changes that define the conflicting contract.
